title: MetricAttribute
description: A non-key annotation on an observation, series, or dataset. Mirrors SDMX cross-domain concepts (OBS_STATUS, UNIT_MEASURE, DECIMALS, CONF_STATUS, COMMENT_OBS) so the SDMX emitter has zero translation work, and adds PublicSchema extensions (cell_count, data_quality_flag) where SDMX has no equivalent. The attachment_level slot drives where the SDMX emitter places each attribute (dataset, series, or observation).

description.description: A free-text summary describing the event, situation, or record.

concept_uri.description: The skos:Concept URI this metric, dimension, or attribute realises. Multiple metrics may share a single concept_uri when they measure the same underlying notion through different operationalisations.

value_range.description: The LinkML range or external code list URI that constrains the values of a dimension or attribute. Named 'value_range' rather than 'range' to avoid shadowing the LinkML keyword.

attachment_level.description: The SDMX attachment level for this attribute: dataset, series (dimension-group), or observation. The level determines where the SDMX emitter places the attribute on output.
